::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 5th [1866]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

Madam,
I am very sorry your last letter was so long unanswered from my having lost it. I fancy I must have torn it up, deceived by the general appearance being like that of the letters of a frequent correspondent. The [Lutheran First Communion](other_books/otherbook_460.qmd) is at p. 544 of [Vol 30](organizations/other_52.qmd)—the [Bells at Weisbaden](other_books/otherbook_459.qmd) at 441 of 29. The amount due for them is 30/ which I will send if you will send me your Christian name to enable me to get a post office order. [Lord Moorlane](other_books/otherbook_461.qmd)[^1] is very amusing, and I will gladly put him in as soon as I can.

Yours faithfully,
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: ‘The History of Lord Moorlane’ by M.M. appeared in *MP* (September 1866) 306-9.
